raw.text:
Is Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) worth it?

Continuing my quest for optimising performance, here are the key takeaways after Week 1 of using a CGM:
- Glucose levels stayed healthy even after big meals & sweets
- More of a health check gadget than daily tool (unlike my Whoop)
- Nutrisense AI helps analyze meal responses

I am planning to finish a 2-week test now, then recheck in 6 months

In general a great tool to get peace of mind if you have glucose concerns, more conclusions in the below video

1） 带小“颈”的皮肤赘生物（腋窝、腹股沟、颈部）。

3） 脚趾、脚踝和小腿的毛发逐渐消失。
4） 过早出现白发和加速衰老。  

记住，这些症状都可以通过生酮饮食逆转！
